evals.prompt: Three investigations using Parallax missed the same deployment-boundary failure. Here are their original predictions, audit reports, production outcomes, and skill versions. Work out what we should learn and whether a skill change is warranted.
evals.expected_output: A portfolio learning review that separates object, method and routing explanations, assesses case dependence, routes the learning into Practice, and proposes a versioned evaluated change only if the evidence clears the structural threshold.
assertions: The output distinguishes at least two possible failure levels
The output assesses dependence between the three cases
The output names a Practice memory or graduation destination
The Practice handoff remains a not-written proposal unless explicit host-workflow write authority is recorded
Any proposed change includes baseline, regression and rollback criteria

evals.prompt: Our onboarding A/B test increased click-through, but six weeks later completion and support outcomes fell. Compare this with the World-Return Contract and decide what should reopen.
evals.expected_output: An outcome-driven review preserving metric and time scales, challenging attribution, reopening the relevant product inference, and distinguishing experiment learning from a general skill-policy change.
assertions: The output distinguishes immediate proxy and later outcome scales
The output identifies an inquiry or decision to reopen
The output does not automatically rewrite a skill from this one case

evals.prompt: We have not shipped yet and have no experiment, incident, evaluation, or observed outcome. Please tell me what the team learned from the release.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to claim learning, with a recommendation to define expectations and a World-Return Contract first.
assertions: The output states that outcome evidence is absent
The output does not invent lessons
The output proposes prospective monitoring or a World-Return Contract
